method: Rebuild / measurement transformation. Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD (direct phone calls). Pre-rebuild genuine phone-lead volume was not separately tracked (recorded conversions were predominantly Google local actions), so the comparison contrasts the pre-management Smart Campaign baseline (2021) with the current measured Search program.

periods.takeover: Late 2022 (genuine call tracking from Sep 2022; dedicated Search + scaled budget from late 2022/2023)

baseline_2021.note: Smart Campaign, ~$300/mo; recorded conversions dominated by local actions (map directions, clicks-to-call), genuine phone-call leads not separately tracked.

now_q2_2026.note: May 2026 was a reduced-spend month ($563), lowering that month's leads and the quarter average.

presentation_note: No cumulative 'total since' figure. Headline = Q2 2026 monthly average (~22 genuine phone leads/mo). Pre-rebuild vanity conversions (map directions/clicks-to-call) deliberately excluded so the before is not over-stated.
